A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown how to construct a GAN that generates high resolution samples with class information, and we provide a method for identifying when the generated samples are diverse and when they are not.
we have developed a method for training generative models with a conditional label that achieves a level of diversity and quality that is comparable to the natural data distribution.
we have developed an improved variant of GAN that is capable of generating high resolution and diverse images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GAN training can be made more stable using label conditioning and a new loss function that we have found to be important.
GAN training can be performed at a much lower resolution and still achieve classification accuracy competitive with the state of the art.
GAN training can be more effectively guided by a discriminator that is conditioned on the correct label.
